verses.text_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Ara-aital lazee yu kazzibu bid deen

translations.text: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
For that is the one who drives away the orphan

verses.transliteration: Wa la ya huddu 'alaa ta'amil miskeen

translations.text: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
So woe to those who pray
[But] who are heedless of their prayer -
Those who make show [of their deeds]
